xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5108: Auto-update harness CLIs (Claude Code first) by default, with a Settings switch to turn it off

plan.title: Auto-update harness CLIs (Claude Code first) by default, with a Settings switch to turn it off
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One feature with one switch: the issue's made decisions require the config key, the Settings switch, the update on refusal in the launch path, the daily background updater, and Needs-you reporting of its failures, so splitting any slice would ship a setting or an updater with no consumer. The surface is 11 small items; 13 of the files are new tests or the CI test-subset list, and the subsystem count is inflated because each doc file and scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt count as their own subsystem. Items that share a file are joined by an edge.

narratives.Problem: A new model whose minClaudeCodeVersion is newer than the installed Claude Code is refused at launch (2026-11-10: Fable 5.2 needs 2.1.321, machine had 2.1.293). Every user hits this after each model launch because nothing keeps harness CLIs current.
narratives.Proposal: Add harnesses.auto_update (default true, machine-wide) with a Settings switch. With it on: (1) a claude-code launch that would be refused runs the runnable Claude Code upgrade plan once through a process-wide update queue, re-checks, and proceeds or raises today's refusal plus the failure; (2) a primary-dashboard service checks npm-installed harness CLIs 2 minutes after boot and every 24 hours, updates outdated ones one at a time, logs one line per outcome, and shows failures in Needs you. With it off, behavior is unchanged. Full detail in .pan/drafts/PAN-5108.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Updating the Overdeck package itself; pan updates stay explicit
- Background updates for non-npm installs (native Claude Code, Kimi, Homebrew, root-owned npm prefix, Windows)
- Running sudo or any root-owned install
- Restarting or touching running agent or conversation sessions after an update
- A cross-process lock between a CLI process and the dashboard
- An immediate pass when the Settings switch is turned back on
- Needs-you items for update-on-refusal failures
- Changes to the Upgrade Claude Code banner or POST /api/claude-code/upgrade
- A per-harness on/off setting
- Any new client-side timeout changes for launch requests
- Any edit to src/dashboard/server/routes/settings.ts or any allowlist cap raise

autoDecisions.summary: Background updater runs only npm-based plans; runnable non-npm plans are skipped and logged
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue decision 4 scopes to npm-based plans; native Claude Code updates itself, and npm view gives a cheap current-version check.

autoDecisions.summary: Update on refusal runs any runnable Claude Code upgrade plan (npm or native), the same command as the existing Upgrade button
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue decision 3 says 'run the Claude Code update plan'; that plan is already vetted for user-writable installs and never runs sudo.

autoDecisions.summary: Added npmPackage: string | null to HarnessUpdatePlan as the npm-based discriminator
autoDecisions.rationale: The plan had no field that distinguishes the npm branch; a data field avoids parsing argv.

autoDecisions.summary: Update commands run with execFile through a new lib module, and fleet 'Update all' moves onto it
autoDecisions.rationale: The launch hook runs in CLI processes and cannot import a dashboard service; one runner and one queue keep two npm global installs from overlapping in a process.

autoDecisions.summary: Process-wide serial update queue keyed by argv; identical requests join; the job re-checks before running
autoDecisions.rationale: Satisfies 'one update at a time' and 'concurrent launches share one update', and covers an update another process finished first.

autoDecisions.summary: Update on refusal: 3-minute timeout and a 15-minute cooldown after a failure
autoDecisions.rationale: Prevents every launch from rerunning (and waiting on) a failing install; the refusal still reports the remembered error.

autoDecisions.summary: harnesses.auto_update is machine-wide: project .pan.yaml cannot set it; hook and service read the global config; a read error means off
autoDecisions.rationale: A committed project file must not change what a machine installs; when the operator's intent cannot be read, do not install.

autoDecisions.summary: The default enablement reader returns false under Vitest
autoDecisions.rationale: Default-on must never run a real npm install -g from a test that reaches the real launch hook or service.

autoDecisions.summary: Needs you is state-based: each pass replaces the failure list; items are non-blocking System items; the phone shows a read-only line
autoDecisions.rationale: Avoids an error toast loop (issue decision 2) and clears itself when a later pass succeeds or auto-update is off.

autoDecisions.summary: Settings switch goes in a new 'Coding Agents' section after Permissions; the YAML write never deletes the harnesses block
autoDecisions.rationale: No existing section fits; a stale browser tab omitting the block must not silently turn auto-update back on.

autoDecisions.summary: A non-runnable plan with auto-update on raises today's refusal unchanged
autoDecisions.rationale: Its message already shows the manual (sudo or brew) command; nothing was attempted, so there is nothing to append.
